text:
LINCOLN, Neb. (KOLN) - Much of the afternoon on Independence Day should be mostly sunny to partly cloudy. Clouds and the chance of rain increase for much of southern and western Nebraska late in the afternoon and evening.

High temperatures for the 4th of July look to be in the mid 80s to around 90.

There is a Marginal to Slight risk for severe weather in part of southern and western Nebraska as well as Northern Kansas. This means isolated to scattered severe thunderstorms are possible with large hail and damaging winds the main threats. The tornado threat is low.

Sunday will be mostly sunny with high temperatures in the upper 80s to upper 90s.

Temperatures should be at or above average for the first half of next week. The best chances for showers and thunderstorms look to be Wednesday and Thursday.
